package.name: flexible_drones
package.description: Aggregate package for the backend-neutral flexible_drones stack: core orchestration, interfaces, shared robot descriptions, and CLI tools. It intentionally does NOT pull in hardware/sim backends (Crazyflie, Gazebo, PiHawk/ArduCopter, OptiTrack) or deployment config, since those are project-specific choices. For CNU SERC lab deployments, build up to chris_serc_deployment instead, which depends on this package plus the specific backends and roster/overlay data used in that lab. Use the flexible_drones_flexbe aggregate package when FlexBE states and behaviors are also needed.
